title: A live child recreates an open annotation after its root finishes
claim: After Finished(root) deletes and closes the root-keyed annotation, a live child can create a new sampled annotation under that already-finished root. The root has no later finish hook to submit or remove the replacement, and finishing the child uses a different key.

title: Annotation capacity admission is not an atomic reservation
claim: trimStore checks map size before distinct-key LoadOrCompute insertion, so concurrent callers can observe capacity before any reserves it. The configured maximum is therefore not established as a hard concurrent admission bound.
